CqrsLens 0.8.0 - see your MediatR codebase.

Usage: cqrslens <path> [-o OUTPUT] [--format md|html|json|agent] [--slice FILTER] [--render mermaid|svg] [--config FILE] [--analysis text|roslyn] [--generated-at ISO8601] [--markers ICommand,IQuery] [--handler-markers ICommandHandler,IQueryHandler] [--watermark TEXT] [--banner|--no-banner] [--color|--no-color] [--baseline FILE] [--write-baseline FILE] [--diff PATH_OR_JSON] [--diff-output FILE] [--sarif FILE] [--summary FILE] [--github-annotations] [--ci-root DIR] [--strict]

  <path>        Folder of the .NET solution to scan (searched recursively).
  -o, --output  Report path. Default: ARCHITECTURE.md (.html or .json) in the current directory.
  --config      Config file. Default: <path>/.cqrslens.json when present.
                Settings: analysis, render, watermark, markers, handlerMarkers, include/exclude globs, layers, rules.
  --format      Report format: md (default), html, json, or agent. A .html, .json, or .agent.md -o path implies that format.
  --slice       Filter and trace vertical slices matching FILTER (endpoint, request, handler, entity, or event).
                Streams directly to stdout when -o is omitted.
  --mcp         Start the built-in Model Context Protocol (MCP) server over JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio.
  --profile     Print per-stage timing and allocation totals to stderr.
  --render      HTML diagram rendering: mermaid (default) or svg (zero-JS inline SVG).
  --analysis    Analysis backend: text (default) or roslyn (opt-in).
  --generated-at  Fixed ISO-8601 timestamp for reproducible reports (tests/CI);
                timing is reported as 0 ms in this mode.
  --markers     Comma-separated custom marker interface names that also count
                as request roots (e.g. ICommand,IQuery,IMessage). Requests hidden
                behind interfaces deriving from IRequest are always followed.
  --handler-markers  Comma-separated custom handler roots for external wrappers
                (e.g. ICommandHandler,IQueryHandler). Source-declared wrappers
[truncated]
